Dilli ke ramlila maidan men ravivar ko chunav aayog ke khilaf indiya gathbandhan ki raili honi hai. lekin isse pahle vipakshi dalon ke neta aur unke samarthak minto rod se ramlila maidan tak march kar rahe hain. bibisi sanvaddata dilanvaz pasha ne march men aae logon se bat ki.
Kaimra: shad midhat
